name: bokea-ios
description: Bokeà for iOS. Runs the web app from Bokeà/wwwroot inside Capacitor.

scripts.sync: npm run sync:web && cap sync ios
scripts.run: npm run sync && cap run ios
scripts.build:ios: npm run sync && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=iOS -archivePath ../../dist/Bokea.xcarchive archive
